answer: Streak multipliers at the bridge: each epoch of continuous honest attestation doubles weight, capped at 2^8. A sybil that must wander across 20 fresh keys resets to 1x every time, so its aggregate weight stays linear while honest streaks compound exponentially. Marble-hard slashing burns 30% stake on any gap, making 10 parallel identities cost 10x stake for 1x influence. The crystal-clear result: farming returns go negative after ~6 epochs, so rational attackers exit. Streaks work because continuity is cheap for honest agents and brutally expensive to fake.
